comment: File-based allow-list for the storage MCP server: one entry per role, naming exactly the storage operations that role may call.

The server reads this file at startup and checks it as the first statement of every operation. A (role, operation) pair that is not listed here is refused with an authorization_denied error naming the role, the operation and the roles that ARE allowed, and the refusal is journalled to the same audit log that records the successful calls.
A role that is absent from 'roles' is an unknown role and is refused, as is a missing or blank role; nothing is defaulted to an allowed role. An empty list means the role is known and holds nothing.

Derived from docs/routing-and-tool-grant-map.json: every 'mcp__storage__<operation>' string under 'grants.<role>' becomes a grant here, and nothing else does. 'mcp__storage__delete_entry' is granted to no role in that map, so every role's entry omits it.
Written as valid JSON with no comments: the explanation lives in these string fields.
derivation: grants[role] filtered to the operations this server exposes; retrieval ceilings do not apply here and are not duplicated in this file

denial_note_by_role.orchestrator: refused every storage operation: it reads and writes orchestration documents instead of project memory
denial_note_by_role.planner: refused update_entry and delete_entry: a plan is a new entry, not a revision or a removal
denial_note_by_role.implementer: refused delete_entry: it revises its own notes and removes no record
denial_note_by_role.tester: refused update_entry and delete_entry: it records a result and alters no earlier record
denial_note_by_role.reviewer: refused update_entry and delete_entry: it stays read-only toward work it did not write and records only its own review
denial_note_by_role.project-manager: refused write_entry, update_entry and delete_entry: it owns ticket state rather than persistent project memory
denial_note_by_role.researcher: refused read_entry and list_entries: it records findings and reads nothing back out of project memory

denial_note_by_operation.delete_entry: refused to every role, so record removal stays outside the gate and audit evidence survives; no role holds a destructive capability here
